messages.subject: Commercial use of seewave
parts:
Dear All in seewave community

I'm someone who is interested in and fascinated by seewave since some years ago. I'd like to ask something here:

is it possible to use seewave for commercial use such as graphics design of posters, book covers, album covers, etc? For instance, it may be graphic design in general accompanying spectrogram plotted by seewave.

of course I will not use it for violating law or public morals.

Best regards,
Daichi Misawa
